title: lychnis laeta subsp. corsica
intro: Lychnis laeta subsp. corsica, commonly known as the Corsican campion, is a plant species within the caryophyllaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the island of Corsica, which is part of France. The Corsican campion is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
